title: LankaEdu LMS Firestore Database Blueprint
description: Firestore schema and access control specifications for LankaEdu LMS Sri Lankan School Management System

admin_config.description: Master Administrator configuration, real-time password verification, and authentication hash settings

password.description: Master password for administrator full-access portal

passwordHash.description: Cryptographic authentication hash of the admin password

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last password update

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the actor who updated the password

isCustomSet.description: Flag indicating if default admin password has been customized

system_settings.description: Global system configurations including Master Administrator credentials

admin_auth.description: Master Administrator authentication and security settings

masterPassword.description: Master password for administrator full-access portal

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last password update

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the actor who updated the password

isCustomSet.description: Flag indicating if default admin password has been customized

teachers.description: Faculty members, employee credentials, subject assignments, and grade authorizations

employeeId.description: Sri Lankan Ministry/School Employee ID (e.g. EMP-4001)

fullName.description: Full legal name of the faculty member

qualification.description: Academic and pedagogical qualifications (e.g. B.Sc, PGDE)

password.description: Portal login password for teacher subject marks entry

isClassTeacherOf.description: Assigned class teacher grade and division if applicable

assignments.description: List of subject and grade assignments authorized for this teacher

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last record modification

users.description: User profiles, registration status, and assigned school role for LankaEdu LMS onboarding

id.description: Unique user ID (e.g. usr_123 or sanitized email key)

name.description: Full name of the registered user

email.description: Official email address used for login

status.description: Account approval status. Defaults to 'pending' upon registration.

assignedRole.description: Assigned portal role. Defaults to 'unassigned' until School Admin approves.

indexNumber.description: Student Examination Index Number if assigned as student

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last account update or role assignment
